title: FBI Vault: 9/11 Collections
summary: The FBI's FOIA library hosts the 9/11 Commission Report investigative files (monthly releases 2001–2004), material released under Executive Order 14040 (2021 declassification review), and Pentagon exterior/interior/debris photos plus emergency-response footage.
tldr: The FBI Vault's 9/11 search index returns 145 items — including the 9/11 Commission Report, EO 14040 declassification releases, Pentagon emergency-response footage (5 parts), and dozens of Pentagon attack-scene photo sets.
ai_summary:
AI review of the FBI Vault 9/11 search index (145 items), read in full:
- Headline holdings: the September 11th Commission Report; '9/11 Material Released in Response to Executive Order 14040' (Biden's Sept 3, 2021 declassification-review order); '9/11 Attacks Investigation and Related Materials'; '9/11 Attacks and Investigation Images.'
- Pentagon: 5-part emergency-response footage set plus extensive photo series (Overhead, Interior, Exterior, Debris, FBI Team shots).
- The Vault describes itself as the FBI's FOIA library: 6,700+ documents scanned from paper to digital.
- Note: this review covers the search index; individual case files within were not opened. Record summary verified consistent.
